headline: Bucharest's Center Taken Over by Malls: All of the Capital's Premium Street Retail Fits Into a Single Shopping Center the Size of ParkLake
summary: Bucharest's central streets have vacant spaces or are occupied by pharmacies, banks and betting shops, while malls are full with waiting lists of tenants.
why: Retail property yields and tenant demand in major European capitals influence real estate investment and the outlook for shopping-centre landlords.

original_headline: Centrul Bucureştiului, confiscat de malluri: tot retailul stradal premium al Capitalei încape într-un singur centru comercial de mărimea ParkLake
